gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action continuing from a past point to now: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's (been) years since + past simple = I haven't done it for years.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.
